title: 2-node XIAO nRF54L15 RPL-UDP (server + client, single hop)

test.description: Single-hop RPL-UDP on the XIAO nRF54L15: the client joins the server's DAG and they exchange request/response end-to-end. Regression test for the bundled images (rebuilt from contiki-ng 509e0b236; the May build asserted in the radio driver).
